task1_cve_linkage.name: CVE Linkage Retrieval
task1_cve_linkage.description: Cross-source, temporally OOD entity grounding: map heterogeneous threat evidence to canonical CVE identifiers.

task2_signal_detection.name: Hacker Signal Detection
task2_signal_detection.description: Two-stage: detect actionable exploit intelligence in hacker discourse, then ground to CVE context.

task3_temporal_generalization.name: Temporal Generalization (Unseen CVE Linkage)
task3_temporal_generalization.description: Link evidence to entirely unseen CVEs (CVE-2024+). Tests prospective generalization to new vulnerabilities.
task3_temporal_generalization.constraint: C_train ∩ C_test = ∅ (strictly disjoint CVE sets by year)
